description:
This.
The joy, the love, the beautiful responsibility.
I remember coming home from a work trip where i was gone from my family for 5 days. My son was about 3.
As I drove up the driveway, my son and wife were waiting outside and my boy came running down the front sideway of our home yelling “dadda!! Dadda I missed you!!”
Honestly, it was a moment that will stay with me until my final moments and I hope is one of the memories that flashes before my eyes before I die.
Being a father is a MASSIVE responsibility. It’s not easy.
I get why many people are afraid of becoming parents - its hard, confronting and brings up a ton of shit that is hard to deal with…
But moments like these are the ones that melt all of the hardship away and bring us back into the understanding of what life and parenting is all about.
